Leave the latte behind as you don your brave face and embark on your own 3 day Top End reality show.
Breath -taking landscapes, crystal streams, star-lit silence is the backdrop.
product.description:
‘Awaken in the Wild’
Litchfield National Park

Mother nature is your host.

Tour Outline

DAY 1 – DARWIN TO LITCHFIELD NATIONAL PARK

Meet Your Guide and Begin the Journey

Start your day by heading to the front of your Darwin accommodation, where you’ll find your expert tour guide ready to whisk you away into the outback.

Initial Exploration

Arriving in Litchfield begin your immersion by tackling some of the more common locales and options.  Included in this will be short hikes on pathways, swims in the clear creeks and waterfalls and general out and aboutedness ! As the sun slides left we make our way to our en-suite accommodation for the night where you can relax on the deck of your room whilst the onsite chef prepares a well deserved feast.

Catering – Lunch & Dinner


DAY 2 – Explore some more

Early Start and Light Breakfast

Begin your day by rising early with the birds, savouring a light breakfast before embarking on our next set of adventures in Litchfield National Park.

Off-the-Beaten-Path Exploration: A Bush Walk to a Remote Waterfall

Today’s highlight is a bush walk leading to a remote waterfall, exclusively accessible by foot. Secluded, quiet, and pristine, this experience offers an unparalleled connection with nature. As you traverse the path, delve into the knowledge of native foods and resources, gaining insights into the traditional methods that the indigenous owners utilized for survival and continue to employ today.

Educational Insights: Traditional Survival Techniques Unveiled

Enrich your understanding of the ingenious techniques employed by the traditional owners to thrive in their environment. Uncover the wealth of information about native foods and resources, enhancing your appreciation for the sustainable practices still prevalent today.

Challenging Terrain: Hike Details

Prepare for a challenging hike covering approximately 6-10 km, featuring sections of trackless walking and steep climbs. This journey promises both physical exertion and breathtaking views, providing a memorable and invigorating experience.

Interactive Evening Experience

As the ochre colours intensify and daylight fades, return to camp for evening snacks and a relaxing campfire experience. Tonight showcases Top End cooking at its finest.  Immerse yourself in an essential part of our experience by trying to ignite a campfire using bush craft techniques. Seize the opportunity to hone your fire-starting skills using nothing but sticks—tap into your inner caveman!

Catering – Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner


DAY 3 – OFFROAD & OUT OF SITE

Day 3 kicks off with a proper outback breakfast at Ridge Retreat before we point the wheels toward some of Litchfield’s lesser-known offroad tracks — seasonal access permitting. This is the Territory at its rawest. Expect corrugations, creek crossings, dust, mud and a few surprises along the way.

Today is for the adventurous. We’ll head well beyond the busy tourist spots and into remote country where the crowds disappear and the landscape takes over. Depending on conditions, we’ll tackle short hikes into hidden pockets of the park, cool off with swims beneath escarpments and waterfalls, and explore places few visitors ever get to see.

Lunch is a relaxed wilderness picnic surrounded by monsoon forest and stone country — no cafés, no bitumen, no rush. Just good food and wild places.

As the afternoon winds down, we’ll make our way south to the iconic Adelaide River Hotel for a cold drink and a chance to swap stories from three unforgettable days in the Top End. Then it’s back to Darwin, dusty, tired and properly connected to the Territory.

Catering – Breakfast, Lunch


What's Included ?

  • Pick up & Drop Off at your hotel
  • Qualified local Australian guide
  • Comprehensive exploration of Litchfield Park
  • All camping equipment
  • Accommodation – camping with optional upgrade to CABINS
  • Catering – where indicated

tour Features

  • Hikes and activities away from the crowds
  • Flexible program to suit your needs and wants
  • Bush craft elements**
  • Swims in clear waterfall fed streams and ponds
  • Ample time for relaxation
  • Hiking and off road driving
  • En-suite accommodation
